hypothesis_evaluation.note: Every threshold word stays INDETERMINATE. No dated owner approval in the reviewed decision set raises any of them; GATE_9_STAGE2_PROTOCOL_APPROVAL.md:44-46 explicitly records that the protocol decision 'does not ... introduce a hypothesis threshold'.

mandatory_conditioning: D006's mapping is not neutral: D(w)=a(s)w(1-w)<0 for every w>1 at every s>0, so unbalanced is under-penalised relative to slack at larger violations. Every unbalanced-vs-slack difference at w>1 is confounded with this known bias (DECISIONS.md:266-296; FROZEN_MATH_SPEC.md:211-214; P-09, P-10, CL-01).

The penalty box is conditioning for every conclusion: m_lo=4 is a recorded judgement and the box neither certifies enforcement nor makes the A-rate box-independent (FROZEN_MATH_SPEC.md:241-243; CL-04).

V-14 is report-only at r=1; its 0.5x m_hi floor-to-zero defect is a recorded judgement and both V-14 scales stay separate from the primary grid and from each other (DECISIONS.md:1829, 1834-1836; CL-05, P-16).

D011 is non-primary, matched-subgrid only, and carries the known positive local curvature-match bias D_CM(w)=s_j*w>0; it is not a D013 trigger input and not rank-stability evidence (DECISIONS.md:1036-1038, 1153; CL-06, P-17).
Exactness rests on frozen judgements, not theorems: epsilon=2^-52 and c_H=c_f=2048 are not universal forward-error bounds (FROZEN_MATH_SPEC.md:404-405; CL-07).
One bad paired record is decisive for essentially every exact count, rate, sign and topology predicate reported here (GATE_9_CONCLUSION_VERIFICATION_MAPPING_DRAFT.md:6-10; CL-16).

Each instance is reported separately first; the cross-instance figure is the mechanical all_five/any_one/count_of_five reduction of five statuses and no rate is pooled (GATE_9_STAGE2_PROTOCOL_DRAFT.md:195-198).
No generalisation beyond the five-instance family is claimed (CLAIMS_AND_LIMITATIONS_REGISTER.md C-21, CL-03).

not_computed.cross_generation_comparison: SLOT-5's 'exact numerator difference versus the matching accepted Gate-5 subset' (RESULTS_AND_FIGURE_SLOTS.md:130) is NOT computed: that subset is a Stage-1 artefact and this pipeline emits no cross-generation comparison
not_computed.d013_ablation_results: the four conditions ran in-kernel only when the trigger fired (full_production_parent_v2.py:119-146); they are not declared families of this reader and no ablation quantity is derived here
not_computed.d015_diagnostic_rates: DECISIONS.md:437-438 — the four (c_H,c_f) pairs are additionally reported and cannot select a primary result; their shape is verified, their counts are not reduced to a second A-rate
not_computed.energies_ties_labels: re-deriving H_E, T_E, X_E, f* or Lambda_ref would be a second scientific computation; every number here is read from a committed, hash-verified reconstruction summary (stage2_cuda_reconstruct.py:196-214)

provenance.verified_by: verify_outputs_v2.py (run separately; its own report hash is supplied by the caller)

purpose: Stage-2 inference over five real production slots. Frozen quantities only: exact censuses, the paired encoding difference, the exact-sign D013 disposition, exact integer spatial predicates, the V-14 and D011 companions, and the mechanical all_five/any_one/count_of_five reduction. No threshold, no winner, no pooling, no boundary fit.
